context_requirements: No defined molecular target for the expectorant class
Expectorant activity is primarily mucolytic/secretolytic in airway epithelium, not a transcriptional program in the tested lineages
Some members (e.g., dextromethorphan) may act on collagen secretion in fibroblasts, but this is not a general class effect and is not expected at 10 uM in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across structurally unrelated expectorants
Enrichment of a specific pathway (e.g., ER stress, collagen secretion) in a dose-dependent manner

evidence.supports: Dextromethorphan, a cough expectorant, inhibits collagen secretion in lung fibroblasts via ER trafficking, but this is a specific drug effect rather than a class-wide transcriptional mechanism
